d:
India is the world's largest milk producer, but it is facing a shortage of milk fat. Rising demand for ghee and butter, increased dairy exports, slowing milk production and regulatory crackdowns are putting pressure on supplies and pushing prices higher.
Why are dairy fat prices rising, and could consumers face further increases? The Indian Express' Harish Damodaran explains the factors behind India's milk fat crisis and what lies ahead for the dairy sector.
Report: Harish Damodaran
Production, Editor & GFX: Faisal Malik
Camera: Madhur Shyam
